inputs: Segment start/range; actual bytes received/sent; timer ticks in monotonic milliseconds.
defaults: Type defaults to FILE; segment starts at (0,-1); pos/actual/start initialize to 0.
effects: Transfer tracks file/segment position separately from actual socket bytes; reset clears positions and samples. tick records (time,pos), updates timestamp without new sample when unchanged, prunes old samples only after >15 seconds while retaining at least 15 samples. Average speed is bytes-per-second from first/last sample; seconds-left uses segment remaining bytes, integer-divided by speed, and returns 0 when speed <=0. isFilelist is true only full/partial list.
errors: Negative/untrusted positions are not validated by addPos; this is a Core-internal mutator and should not be exposed directly. getSecondsLeft(wholeFile=true) casts base Transfer to Upload, so using it on a Download is unsafe; avoid whole-file mode except verified Upload.
behavior.completion: Progress is a mutable snapshot updated by transfer callbacks/timer ticks.
resources: Each Transfer references its owning UserConnection and maintains a mutex-protected sample deque.

ownership_evidence: Transfer stores UserConnection by reference and monotonically assigned TransferToken; non-copyable.
threading_evidence: Sample deque is protected by SharedMutex for tick and average-speed reads; pos/actual updates are unguarded in Transfer.cpp:146-156 and occur on transfer connection path.
records.proposed_bridge_requirement: Expose immutable progress values and documented units; bridge owns mutation only through Core transfer lifecycle, and never invokes unsafe whole-file ETA on Download.
acceptance_scenarios: Given a transfer has samples with changed positions over time, when average speed is calculated, then the result is the delta bytes per second over retained sample endpoints.
Given a transfer has no positive average speed, when seconds-left is queried for the current segment, then it returns zero.
Given a Download object, when bridge code computes remaining time, then it never calls wholeFile=true because the implementation downcasts to Upload.

inputs: ConnectionQueueItem events, per-connection token, hinted user, connection type/hub and QueueManager state.
effects: Manager subscribes to connection/download/upload managers at construction and removes listeners at destruction. Added ignores PM connections; otherwise creates a TransferInfo keyed by connection token, initializes status Connecting and download queue metadata, inserts it, then emits Added. Connecting marks WAITING, updates status/hub and queue metadata, then Updated with STATUS/TARGET/TYPE/SIZE/QUEUE_ID/STATE/USER flags. Forced sets connecting-forced status and state WAITING unless currently RUNNING. UserUpdated changes hub hint and emits USER. Failed sets last bundle; OLD_CLIENT overrides error with SOURCE_TOO_OLD; marks FAILED, sets speed/bytes/timeLeft to -1, emits Updated then Failed, and avoids duplicate failure overwrite. Removed erases before Removed event.

persistence: In-memory only; no transfer-info disk persistence.

inputs: Download/Upload Starting, Requesting, Tick, Failed, Complete and Idle callbacks; transfer’s position, target, range, speed, remote IP/encryption/supports/flags.

acceptance_scenarios: Given a download reaches Requesting then Starting, when TransferInfoManager handles both, then the first update includes requested status/full metadata and the later update adds final size/flags without duplicating unavailable initial fields.

inputs: Transfer binds a UserConnection, path and TTH; TransferInfo binds a HintedUser, download/upload direction and string token; TransferSlot contains slot type and source identity.
preconditions: TransferInfoManager singleton dependencies (DownloadManager, UploadManager, ConnectionManager) must exist at construction.
defaults: Transfer begins with segment (0,-1) and a new token; TransferInfo token is allocated by IncrementingIdCounter; timeLeft and size default -1; TransferSlot values have no default constructor in the shown contract.
effects: Transfer stores the supplied connection/path/TTH and generated token. TransferInfo stores identity/direction/string token and generated TransferInfoToken. TransferInfoManager registers itself with download, upload and connection listeners in constructor and removes those registrations in destructor. TransferSlot::toType(optional) returns the contained type or NOSLOT when absent.
errors: No constructor error result; singleton listener dependencies are assumed initialized.
behavior.completion: Synchronous value construction and listener registration/removal.
behavior.cancellation: Not applicable to constructors; listener teardown occurs at manager destruction.
resources: Transfer holds a reference to UserConnection and owns its sample/segment values; TransferInfo is shared_ptr-managed; manager listener registrations are non-owning.

ownership_evidence: Transfer.cpp:39-40 initializes path, segment, TTH, UserConnection reference and generated token. TransferInfoManager.cpp:37-46 adds/removes three listener registrations.
threading_evidence: Transfer speed/sample state uses its own SharedMutex; TransferInfoManager protects transfer map operations with SharedMutex. Constructor/destructor registration is synchronous.
records.proposed_bridge_requirement: Represent TransferSlot and TransferInfo as copied values; never expose Transfer connection references or native listener interfaces.
acceptance_scenarios: Given no optional transfer slot, when TransferSlot::toType is called, then it returns NOSLOT. Given TransferInfoManager construction/destruction, when lifecycle completes, then registrations with all three managers are paired.
